test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was appointed as UNICEF's global Goodwill Ambassador in 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Millie Bobby Brown**__.

__
 
• **On 20 November 2018, Emmy-nominated actress Millie Bobby Brown has been announced as UNICEF’s newest Goodwill Ambassador**.

 
 
• The appointment – marked on World Children’s Day at United Nations Headquarters and the Empire State Building in New York – makes the 14-year-old UNICEF’s youngest-ever Goodwill Ambassador.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Millie Bobby Brown** is a British actress.

 
 
• In 2018, Brown was featured on the Time 100 list of the world's most influential people and was appointed as a UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador, the youngest person ever elected to the position.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **List of UNICEF Goodwill Ambassadors**

 
 
• Serbia Novak Djokovic (August 2015)
 
• India Priyanka Chopra (December 2016)
 
• Canada Lilly Singh (July 2017)
 
• United Kingdom Millie Bobby Brown (November 2018)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lily Singh **is a Canadian comedian, actress, former talk show host and YouTuber who formerly appeared under the pseudonym Superwoman, her longtime YouTube username. Born and raised in Scarborough, Ontario, Singh began making YouTube videos in 2010.
 
• **Novak Djokovic** is a Serbian professional tennis player.
 
 
• He is currently ranked world No. 1 by the Association of Tennis Professionals as of 21 March 2022. 
 
 
 
• **Priyanka Chopra Jonas** is an Indian actress, model and singer. The winner of the Miss World 2000 pageant, Chopra is one of the highest-paid actresses of India.
 
 
• He has received several awards, including two National Film Awards and five Filmfare Awards.
